decision: One bounded unchanged learning-duration experiment; retain latest actor, critic, Adam, normalizer and RNG. No rollback or diagnostic policy import.
rationale: Integrity and foundation certification checks passed. Training produced 33 events over 279 completed rounds versus 15 over 238 in the preceding invocation, but falls increased from 13/238 to 30/279 and deterministic evaluation regressed to 7/8 survival and zero contacts. Sampled replay and zero-navigation interventions did not restore contacts. Zero-arm intervention restored 8/8 survival but no contacts, implicating arm/body coordination rather than frozen legs or numerical failure. Sparse-contact PPO has received only 262144 transitions under the corrected range; allow a finite additional 524288 to test learning duration without introducing another unisolated reward or range change. This is an experiment, not evidence that more steps solve it.
review_next: Evaluate latest checkpoint at 1048576 using unchanged complete eight-episode physical evaluation and inspect intermediate events/falls. If independent contacts or survival do not recover, do not grant another unchanged duration extension: run a bounded controlled reward/exploration comparison with separately recorded diagnostic compute. No boxing certification or foundation promotion is implied.
